tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently joined a new fitness class at the campus gym and have been enjoying the workouts. However, you are experiencing some difficulty with certain exercises. You would like to ask the instructor, Ms. Miller, for her advice and express your appreciation for her guidance so far. Write an email to Ms. Miller.
bullets: Mention what you enjoy about the fitness class.
Describe the difficulty you are having with certain exercises.
Ask for advice to address the difficulty you are having.
tasks.subject: Request for advice in fitness class
